descriptions.zh: 在我们探索繁星之前我们需要先拓宽视野。幸好，我们有一张复杂的§S星系地图§!可用。要打开星系地图，你可以按§SM§!键或是屏幕底部的星系按钮。之后就可以按§SEsc§!或是右上角的按钮关闭情报日志了。
descriptions.en: Before we can explore the stars we need to broaden our view. Thankfully, we have a sophisticated §SGalaxy Map§! at our disposal. To access the Galaxy Map, you can either press §SM§! or the Galaxy Button at the bottom of your screen. Afterwards feel free to close the Situation Log by either pressing §SEsc§! or the button in the top right.

descriptions.zh:
首先选中我们的£science_ship£§S科研船§!。你可以在§H星系地图§!上直接点击§S舰船§!或是从§S总览§!中选中。

然后在察看§S星系地图§!的同时，在左下角的舰队界面点击§S调查§!按钮，然后选择一个没有调查过的£system£§S恒星系§!。你也可以右键点击一个未调查的恒星系然后选择§S调查恒星系§!。

我们的§S科研船§!会自动对那个恒星系内的所有天体进行调查。
descriptions.en:
Begin by selecting our £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!. This can be done by clicking on the §SShip§! on the §HGalaxy Map§! or by selecting it from the §SOutliner§!.

While viewing the §SGalaxy Map§!, click the §SSurvey§! button on the fleet interface in the lower left corner, then select a non-surveyed £system£ §SSystem§!. Alternatively, you can right-click on a non-surveyed system and select §SSurvey System§!.

Our §SScience Ship§! will now chart a course and survey all planetary bodies within that system.

descriptions.zh:
我们需要研发新科技。§S新世界协议§!将使我们可以建造£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!，如果我们要扩张自己的帝国，那我们应该尽快研发它。

点击顶部界面左端的按钮或是按下§SF4§!键来开启§S科技§!界面。然后点击§S选择研究§!并从中挑选一项科技作为研究目标。
descriptions.en:
We need to research new technologies. The §SNew Worlds Protocol§! will enable us to construct £colony_ship£ §SColony Ships§!, and we should focus on this as soon as possible if we are to expand our empire.

Access the §STechnology§! screen by clicking its button in the left section of the top bar or by pressing §SF4§!. Then click on §SSelect Research§! and pick a technology to pursue from the options available.

descriptions.zh:
如果您想要开发被£science_ship£§S科研船§!发现的资源，那么您需要派遣£construction_ship£§S工程船§!执行相关任务。

点击恒星基地选择§S船坞§!界面。再在几个选项中选择§S工程船§!。

注意您需要足够的£alloys£§S合金§!才能开始建造这些§S舰船§!。
descriptions.en:
We will need a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! if we are to exploit the resources that are discovered by our £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!.

Click on our Starbase and select the §SShipyard§! tab, then select §SConstruction Ship§! from among the available choices.

Note that you will need to have amassed enough £alloys£ §SAlloys§! to afford the §SShip§! before its construction can begin.

descriptions.zh:
想开发£planet£§S行星§!上的£minerals£§S矿物§!或者§S战略资源§!矿藏，需要在轨道上建立£mining_station£§S开采站§!。为此，你需要选择£construction_ship£§S工程船§!，可以直接点击工程船或者在§S总览§!选择。

选中之后，在工程船的舰队界面点击§S[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站§!按钮，然后点击拥有矿藏的可用行星或小行星。

注意，建造£mining_station£§S开采站§!会花费£minerals£§S矿物§!资源，所以在建造前一定要确保拥有足够的矿物。
descriptions.en:
Before a £minerals£ §SMineral§! deposit or a §SStrategic Resource§! can be collected from a £planet£ §SPlanet§!, a £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! needs to be built in orbit. To do this, select your £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! either by clicking directly on it or by finding it in the §SOutliner§! on the right side of the screen.

Once this has been done, click on the §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Station§! button in the Construction Ship's fleet interface. Then click on an available planet or asteroid with a Mineral deposit.

Note that building a £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! also costs £minerals£ §SMinerals§!, so you will need to have a sufficient amount stored before construction can begin.

descriptions.zh:
当£science_ship£§S科研船§!已经准备探索星系时，所需要做的只有取消暂停了。只需要简单地按下§S空格键§!£space£或在顶部栏点击以下按钮即可：

                                    £pause_button£
descriptions.en:
With a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! standing by to explore the galaxy, all that is left is to unpause. To do this, simply press the §SSpace Bar§! £space£ or select the following icon in the top bar:

                                    £pause_button£

descriptions.zh:
为了提升我们研究新技术的速度，请在拥有£physics£§S物理§!，£society£§S社会§!或£engineering£§S工程§!资源的行星上建立£science_ship£§S研究站§!。

研究站的工作方式和£mining_station£§S开采站§!类似，其区别在于收集的资源不一样。研究站无法收集£strategic_resource£§S战略资源§!和£minerals£§S矿物§!。

要建造研究站，需要选择一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!，并在舰队界面选择§S[GetBuildGrowCap]研究站§!的按钮，然后点击含有拥有物理、社会或工程资源的£planet£§S行星§!、小行星或恒星之上。
descriptions.en:
To improve the rate at which we research new technologies, £science_ship£ §SResearch Stations§! should be built above any world that possesses £physics£ §SPhysics§!, £society£ §SSociety§! or £engineering£ §SEngineering§! resources.

Research Stations function much in the same way as £mining_station£ §SMining Stations§! - their sole difference is in the resources they collect. They are not capable of mining £minerals£ §SMinerals§! or £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§!.

To build one, select your £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! and click on the §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Research Station§! button in its fleet interface. Then click on an available £planet£ §SPlanet§!, asteroid or sun that has a deposit of Physics, Society or Engineering resources.

descriptions.zh:
我们的母星已经有少量£building£§S建筑§!，但我们应该继续建造。

要完成这项任务，首先在§S总览§!点击我们的母星，点击§S地表§!选项卡。在一个区划中点击一个空白建筑槽，并从可用建筑中选择。只要我们拥有足够§S资源§!，建造就会立即开始。

建筑提供£job£§S岗位§!，但在有£pops£§S人口§!被委派上去工作之前不会有任何产出。你可以在§S经济§!选项卡中查看你的§S人口§!都在从事什么岗位的工作。
descriptions.en:
Our homeworld already has a small number of £building£ §SBuildings§!, but we should build another one.

To do this, select the homeworld in the §SOutliner§! and click on the §SSurface§! tab. Select an empty building slot in a district, and choose from one of the available buildings. Assuming we have enough §SResources§!, construction will begin immediately.

Buildings provide £job£ §SJobs§!, but nothing will be produced until £pops£ §SPops§! are assigned to work there. You can check which jobs your §SPops§! are performing in the §SEconomy§! tab.

descriptions.zh:
我们母星上的一些=£blocker£§S障碍§!妨碍了§S区划§!的进一步开发，罪当清除。这就需要花费§S资源§!。

要清理§S障碍§!，在§S管理§!选项卡中找到障碍，然后点击其上的§S清理障碍按钮§!。


                                        £clear_blocker£


清理不同的§S障碍§!需要的花费和时间也有所不同。
descriptions.en:
Several £blocker£ §SBlocker§! on our homeworld are preventing the construction of additional §SDistricts§!, and should be cleared. This takes time and costs §SResources§!.

To clear a §SBlocker§!, click the §SClear Blocker§! button on the blocker itself, which can be found on the §SManagement§! tab.


                                        £clear_blocker£


§SBlockers§! have different costs, technology requirements, and times associated with clearing them.

descriptions.zh:
我们需要在£system£§S母星系§!外扩张我们的帝国。首先要做的就是调查邻近星系。

要进行探索，请选择你的£science_ship£§S科研船§!，在舰队界面点击§S调查§!按钮，然后点击屏幕下方的§S打开星系地图§!按钮，选择一个邻近星系。§S科研船§!会自动前往该星系，调查其中的全部天体。
descriptions.en:
We need to expand our influence beyond our home £system£ §SSystem§!, and the first step towards doing this is to survey the neighboring star systems.

To do this, select your £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! and click on the §SSurvey§! button in its fleet interface. Then click on the §SOpen Galaxy Map§! button at the bottom of the screen, and select one of the stars neighboring our own. The §SScience Ship§! will now journey to this star system and survey all bodies within.

descriptions.zh:
我们应该考虑[GetBuildingGrowing]第二艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!来加速星系的探索进度。

点击恒星基地选择§S船坞§!选项卡。再在几个选项中选择§S科研船§!。

注意您需要足够的£alloys£§S合金§!才能开始建造这艘§S舰船§!。
descriptions.en:
We should consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! to increase the speed at which we survey our region of the galaxy.

Click on our Starbase and select the §SShipyard§! tab, then select §SScience Ship§! from among the available choices.

Note that you will need to have amassed enough £alloys£ §SAlloys§! to afford the §SShip§! before its construction can begin.

descriptions.zh:
我们或许应当考虑雇佣一名新的£scientist£§S科学官§!来指挥全新的£science_ship£§S科研船§!。虽然科研船可以在没有科学家的情况下继续探索，但是失去了科学家的指导，他们便无法探测到§S异常现象§!。

选择我们的新科研船，点击§S指派领袖§!。§S领袖§!页面会展开，显示为我们服务的所有科学家。在列表顶部点击§S招募§!按钮。

选择你想要的科学家，然后点击§S招募§!按钮。招募领袖会花费£unity£§Y凝聚力§!，请务必储存足够。

招募完毕后，新的科学家便会在母星中等待安排。
descriptions.en:
We need a £scientist£ §SScientist§! to command our new £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!, as it cannot survey or research §SAnomalies§! without one.

Select our new §SScience Ship§!, and then click on the portrait in the fleet interface. The §SSelect a Leader§! window will open, showing all §SScientists§! currently employed by us and those available for hire. Select the candidate you want.

Recruiting a Leader costs £unity£ §YUnity§!, and you may need to wait until you have enough stored.

Once recruited, the §SScience Ship§! can begin to explore.

descriptions.zh:
现在该殖民另一颗星球了。首先我们得[GetBuildGrow]一艘£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!。[GetBuildGrow]这种§S舰船§!需要花很长时间，以及大量的£alloys£§S合金§!、£food£§S食物§!和£consumer_goods£§S消费品§!，但兴旺发展的£colony£§S殖民地§!带来的回报远远大于这笔投入。

点击你的§S恒星基地§!，打开§S船坞§!选项卡。然后从各种选项中点击选择§S殖民船§!。

请注意，在建造开始之前，你必须先积累足够的资源。
descriptions.en:
The time has come to colonize another world. First we will have to [GetBuildGrow] a £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!. These §SShips§! take a long time to [GetBuildGrow] and require a large amount of £alloys£ §SAlloys§!, £food£ §SFood§!, and £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§!, but a thriving £colony£ §SColony§! will more than return on this investment.

Click on your §SStarbase§! and open the §SShipyard§! tab. Then select §SColony Ship§! from the available designs.

You'll need enough resources before construction can begin.

descriptions.zh:
现在我们该用新造的£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!来设立我们的第一个£colony£§S殖民地§!。最佳的候选星球是与我们的母星类型相同的星球，这样我们的殖民者在适应环境方面不会有任何问题。

要殖民一颗£planet£§S行星§!，点击你的§S殖民船§!，或者在§S总览窗口§!中选中它。然后在其舰队界面中点击§S殖民§!按钮，并选择你想殖民的星球。注意你只能在已调查并且没有§S异常点§!的星球上殖民。星球也必须位于你的境内。虽然你可以选择在宜居性较低的星球上殖民，但代价会非常高昂。
descriptions.en:
We should now use our new £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§! to establish our first £colony£ §SColony§!. The best planetary candidates are those that are of the same planet class as our homeworld - our colonists will have no problems adjusting to their environments.

To colonize a £planet£ §SPlanet§!, click on your §SColony Ship§! or select it in the §SOutliner§!. Then click on the §SColonize§! button in its fleet interface, and select the planet you want to colonize. Note that you can only colonize planets that have been surveyed and have no §SAnomalies§!. They must also be located within your borders. While you can choose to colonize low Habitability planets, doing so can be very expensive.

descriptions.zh:
我们需要招募一名§S总督§!来管理我们新的£colony£§S殖民地§!。要进行招募，可点击殖民地，进入到§S殖民地总览§!标签中，在§S总督§!窗口点击§S更换§!按钮。此时会展开一个§S领袖§!窗口，显示现在为我们工作的总督。

在屏幕上方点击§S招募§!按钮，选择一名可供使用的总督。注意，招募领袖会花费£unity£§Y凝聚力§!。如果储备不足，就要等到收集足够后再进行招募。

新总督招募完毕后将会在母星等待安排。
descriptions.en:
We should recruit a §SGovernor§! to administer our new £colony£ §SColony§!. To do this, click on the colony and go into its §SColony Summary§! tab. Then click on the §SChange§! button in the §SGovernor§! window. This will open the §SLeaders§! screen, showing the Governors currently working for us.

Click on the §SRecruit§! button in the upper portion of the screen, and select from among the available candidates. Note that Leaders always cost £unity £§YUnity§! to recruit. If we lack the needed amount, we will have to wait until enough has been generated to afford the leader.

Once recruited, the new Governor will be awaiting assignment on our homeworld.

titles.zh: 教程：建立更多的殖民地

descriptions.zh:
以建立£colony£§S殖民地§!的方式继续扩张我们的帝国。我们有充足的£alloys£§S合金§!、£food£§S食物§!和£consumer_goods£§S消费品§!时，就[GetBuildGrowCap]更多£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!，然后让它们去建立更多殖民地。

小心，不要在殖民地发展阶段同时建立过多的殖民地，因为他们能够自己自足之前一直会消耗£energy£§S能量币§!。
descriptions.en:
Continue to expand our empire by founding new £colony£ §SColonies§!. [GetBuildGrowCap] more £colony_ship£ §SColony Ships§! when we have enough £alloys£ §SAlloys§!, £food£ §SFood§!, and £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§! then send them off to establish new colonies.

Take care not to have too many colonies under development at the same time, since they drain £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§! until they become self-sufficient.

descriptions.zh:
我们不断成长的工业渴求原料，因此必须增加£minerals£§S矿物§!的产量。我们可以在有矿物储藏的£planet£§S行星§!和小行星上[GetBuildingGrowing]£mining_station£§S开采站§!，或是在某个已殖民的星球表面上建造§S采矿区划§!。

空间站和£building£§S建筑§!都需要£energy£§S能量币§!来维护，因此我们也需要保证这项资源的充足供应。能量币由已殖民星球上的§S发电区划§!生产，也可以通过在有能量币储藏的行星、小行星和恒星上建造§S开采站§!来生产。
descriptions.en:
Our growing industry is ravenous for raw materials, and we need to increase our supply of £minerals£ §SMinerals§!. This is done by [GetBuildingGrowing] £mining_station£ §SMining Stations§! above £planet£ §SPlanets§! and asteroids with Mineral deposits, or by building §SMining Districts§! on the surface of one of our inhabited planets.

As both stations and £building£ §SBuildings§! cost £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§! to maintain, we need to establish an ample supply of this resource as well. Energy Credits are produced by §SGenerator Districts§! on the surface of our inhabited planets. They can also be acquired by §SMining Stations§! built over planets, asteroids or suns with Energy Credit deposits.

descriptions.zh:
我们必须[GetBuildGrow]一支强大的星际舰队，以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。

目前来看，我们需要再[GetBuildGrowCap]几艘§S护卫舰§!。等到§S合金§!储量足够的时候，我们可以在§S恒星基地§!中进行。新造的军舰会自动并入位于建造它的§S恒星基地§!轨道上现有的舰队。

为了最大化舰队的战斗力，我们可以为其指派一位§S舰队司令§!。这会让这支舰队在面对那些没有£commander£§S指挥官§!管辖的舰队时更具优势。
descriptions.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] a potent starfleet to uphold the [Root.GetName].

A few more §SCorvettes§! should do, for now. [GetBuildGrowCap] the §SShips§! at a §SStarbase§! when our §SAlloy§! supplies permit. New military ships always join any existing fleets in orbit of the §SStarbase§! that builds them.

To optimize a fleet's military power, we may choose to assign it an §SAdmiral§!. This would give it an edge over other fleets, most of which serve without a £commander£ §SCommander§! of their own.

descriptions.zh: 我们应该指派一位§S总督§!来管理我们的新§S星域§!。星域中的所有£planet£§S行星§!将受益于总督的能力等级与特质。
descriptions.en: We should assign a §SGovernor§! to administrate our new §SSector§!. All £planet£ §SPlanets§! within the sector will then benefit from the effects of the Governor's skill level and traits.

descriptions.zh:
要设计一种新的舰船，在侧边栏打开§S舰队管理§!或按§SF9§!后，点击打开§S舰船设计器§!。点击§S新设计§!按钮，在选择§S舰船尺寸§!时选择§S护卫舰§!。点击§S无区段§!按钮为该设计选择一个§S区段§!。

护卫舰是最小型的战舰，它只有一个区段。更大型的舰船区段更多。区段的种类决定了§S武器§!和§S通用§!槽位。选择一个区段后，用各种不见填满，并注意保证能源供给虫族。

通过点击§S自动装配§!可以简化该流程，让游戏自动完成设计。
descriptions.en:
To create a new ship design, go into the §SShip Designer§! by clicking on the §SFleet Management§! in the left side bar, or press §SF9§!. Click on the §SNew Design§! button, and select §SCorvette§! when you are prompted to select a §SHull Size§!. Click the §SNo Section§! button to select a §SSection§! for the design.

Corvettes, the smallest warships, have only one section, while larger ships have more. Sections determine §SWeapon§! and §SUtility§! slots. Pick one, then fill the slots with components, ensuring power remains positive.

To simplify the process, click §SAuto-complete Ship§! and let the game finalize the design.

descriptions.zh:
我们应该在一个§S[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]社会§!的母星上方[GetBuildGrow]§S观测站§!。这些空间站可以完成多种不同的§S任务§!，而任务的种类则取决于我们想要如何影响这些发展中的文明。

观测站的建造方式与£mining_station£§S开采站§!和£science_ship£§S科研站§!相同，但只能造在[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]文明的母星上方。只需要选择一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!，然后在其舰队界面中点击§S[GetBuildGrowCap]观测站§!。

接下来选择你想要研究的[Owner.GetPreFTLUpperPlural]文明的母星，工程船就会自动开始建造。
descriptions.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] an §SObservation Post§! above the homeworld of a §S[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] society§!. These space stations can perform a number of different §SMissions§!, although our willingness to interfere with developing cultures will determine which ones are available.

Observation Posts are built in the same way as £mining_station£ §SMining§! or £science_ship£ §SResearch Stations§!, but they can only be constructed over the homeworlds of [Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] Civilizations. Simply select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!, then click on the §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Observation Post§! button in its fleet interface.

Now select the homeworld of the [Owner.GetPreFTLUpperPlural] you wish to study, and the Construction Ship will begin its mission.

descriptions.zh:
我们应该在拥有£strategic_resource£§S战略资源§!的天体轨道上[GetBuildGrow]一个£mining_station£§S开采站§!。这些稀有的原料拥有巨大的战略价值。

通过§S调查§!找到这类资源后，选取一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!，然后选择§S[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站§!，然后点击相应的天体，即可进行建造。
descriptions.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! in orbit of an astronomical object with a £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resource§!. These rare materials have immense strategic value.

Having located such a resource through §SSurveying§!, select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!, click on the §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Station§! button and then on the appropriate astronomical object.

descriptions.zh: 我们在一个有£strategic_resource£§S战略资源§!的天体的轨道上建造了一个£mining_station£§S开采站§!。这些需要前置科技才能开采的资源能带来巨大的战略价值，我们要一直去搜寻它们。
descriptions.en: We have built a £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! in orbit of an astronomical object with a £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resource§!. These rare materials require specific technologies to mine have immense strategic value, and we should always be on the lookout for them.

descriptions.zh:
我们应该§S提升§!一个低等物种，不过首先我们需要研究§S基因表达学机制§!科技。

§S提升§!未开智的物种，可以访问§S物种§!界面并选中该物种，然后点击提升按钮。
descriptions.en:
We should §SUplift§! a lesser species, though we may need to research the §SEpigenetic Triggers§! technology first.

§SUplift§! a pre-sapient species by selecting their entry in the §SSpecies§! screen, and then clicking on the Uplift button.

descriptions.zh:
我们在宇宙空间的黑暗之中与未知的存在遭遇了，最好尝试着§S建立通讯§!。

可以通过在§S情报日志§!中选择对应的§S第一次接触§!项目，点击§S显示第一次接触§!按钮，或者在§S星系地图§!上点击§S第一次接触§!图标来直接访问。


                                            £firstcontact£
descriptions.en:
Having encountered unknown entities in the blackness of space, we should attempt to §Sestablish communications§!. 

This can be achieved by selecting §SFirst Contact§! in the §SSituation Log§! and clicking the §SShow First Contact§! button, or alternatively, by clicking the §SFirst Contact§! icon on the §SGalaxy Map§! to access it directly.


                                            £firstcontact£

descriptions.zh:
我们可以§S修饰§!住在我们帝国的任何开智种族，如果他们有足够的§S特质点数§!的话。

通过§S物种§!界面的§S修饰§!菜单，然后研究§S特殊项目§!。这个项目需要£society£§S社会学研究§!，并且在执行项目时会暂停正在进行的社会学研究。
descriptions.en:
We can §SModify§! any sapient species living within our empire, provided they have enough §STrait Points§!.

This can be achieved by accessing the §SModify§! menu from the §SSpecies§! screen, and then researching the appropriate §SSpecial Project§!. The project requires £society£ §SSociety research§! and will divert all our technological progress in that field while it is active.

descriptions.zh:
我们可以通过在外星球轨道上建造[GetBuildingGrowing]§S恒星基地§!来扩大我们的领土。这类前哨的存在宣示了我们对这颗恒星及其周围£system£§S星系§!的控制，也就意味着我们有权对其资源进行采集，并禁止已有过接触的外星种群随便进入。

选择一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!，在舰队界面上点击§S[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地§!，然后左键点击一颗恒星。或者可以右键点击恒星然后点击§S[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地§!。

与其他轨道站不同的是，§S恒星基地§!可以在我们的边境之外建造
descriptions.en:
We can expand our borders by [GetBuildingGrowing] §SStarbases§! around alien stars. This secures the £system£ §SSystem§!, grants resource access, and blocks passage for contacts if borders are closed.

Select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!, then click the §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase§! button in its fleet interface and left-click a star. Alternatively, right-click the star and select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase§!.

Unlike other orbital stations, §SStarbases§! can be built outside of our borders.
